record.edic_text:
900 bathuno {bath-oo'-no}

from 901;; v

AV - dig deep + 4626 1; 1

1) 'the deep' sea (the 'high seas')
2) deep, extreme poverty, the deep things of God, things hidden
   and above man's scrutiny, especially divine counsels
3) to make deep
